name: Name
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {count} characters.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Welcome back to {appName}. Enter your details to continue.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.unverifiedBody: Your password was correct, but this address has not been confirmed yet. We have just sent you a new confirmation link. Open it, then sign in.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Set up your {appName} account in a few seconds.
register.verifyBody: We sent a verification link to <email></email>. Click it to activate your account, then sign in.
register.closedDescription: New sign-ups are currently disabled on this instance.
register.closedBody: Ask an administrator for an invitation, or sign in if you already have an account.
register.bootstrapDescription: No account exists on {appName} yet. The one you create now administers it.
register.bootstrapNotice: You are creating the administrator account for this installation.
register.keyRequired: This installation asks for a registration key.
register.keyInvalid: That registration key is not valid.
register.verifyResent: If that address has an account, a new link is on its way.

resendError.rate-limited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
resendError.mail-unavailable: This installation cannot send mail. Ask an administrator to confirm your address.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter the email tied to your account and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.unavailableDescription: Password reset by email is not available here.
forgot.unavailableBody: This installation has no outgoing mail configured, so no reset link can be sent. Ask an administrator to set a new password for you.
forgot.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for <email></email>, you'll receive a link to reset your password shortly.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a strong password you don't use anywhere else.
reset.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.expiredDescription: This password reset link is invalid or has already been used.
reset.expiredBody: Request a fresh link and we'll email you a new one.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
twoFactor.codeMismatch: That code didn't match. Try again.

invite.title: Set up your account
invite.description: An administrator created an account for you on {appName}. Choose a password to finish.
invite.expiredTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
invite.expiredDescription: The link has expired or has already been used.
invite.expiredBody: Invitations are valid for seven days. Ask the administrator to send a new one.

error.invalid: This invitation link is no longer valid.
error.weak-password: A password needs at least 8 characters.
error.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.sign-in-failed: Your password was set, but signing you in failed. Sign in with it now.
